xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:BriefDetailsOfCyberSecurityInc: Updater Services Limited - On March 11, 2025 a cyber security incident occurred when an Office 365 admin account was compromised, prompting immediate action by the IT team to suspend the account, investigate the breach, and work with Microsoft to restore it. Unauthorized access raised concerns about potential access security and multifactor authentication and the Company engaged external consultant to evaluate root cause analysis. The account was fully restored by March 18, 2025, with enhanced security including password resets, multi-factor authentication (MFA), and increased monitoring. A security audit was conducted, and employees were briefed on phishing threats and secure password practices. Preventive measures like stronger multifactor authentication and improved activity monitoring were also implemented to prevent future incidents. No data loss, financial loss or business disruptions had occurred due to this incident.

Denave India Private Limited (Material Subsidiary of Updater Services Limited) - On 16th March 2025, the private key for an API usage account was compromised, allowing an external unknown party to deploy virtual machines on Google Cloud Platform resulting in inorganic billing of 4.42 crores. Upon discovering the issue, the server administrator immediately blocked the account and contacted the billing partner to raise a dispute. Following a detailed Root Cause Analysis and log validation by Internal IT Team, it is confirmed that account was hacked, and some form of bot or script was used to generate large number of compute instances using another service account created to action this. Simultaneously, Incident reporting has been made to CERT-In and cyber police and the billing partner has raised Google Cloud Support Ticket on 2nd April 2025 on the excess billing and resolution is expected to take place by May 11, 2025
